@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls", QUEUE_CLASSES)
def test_readd_updates_priority(cls):
    pq = cls()
    pq.add("a", 0)
    pq.add("b", 5)
    pq.add("c", 10)
    # Raise a's priority to the top
    pq.add("a", 100)
    assert len(pq) == 3
    assert pq.pop() == "a"
    assert pq.pop() == "c"
    assert pq.pop() == "b"
